title: Proclamation No. 426, s. 2012
text:
MALACAÑAN PALACE MANILA

PROCLAMATION NO. 426

DECLARING THURSDAY, 30 AUGUST 2012, AS A SPECIAL (NON-WORKING) DAY IN THE CITY OF MANDAUE

WHEREAS, the City of Mandaue marks its 43 rd Charter Day anniversary on Thursday, 30 August 2012;

WHEREAS, it is but fitting and proper that the people of the City of Mandaue be given full opportunity to celebrate and participate in the occasion with appropriate ceremonies.

NOW, THEREFORE, I, PAQUITO N. OCHOA JR., Executive Secretary, by authority of His Excellency, BENIGNO S. AQUINO III, do hereby declare Thursday, 30 August 2012, as a special (non-working) day in the City of Mandaue.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, I have hereunto set my hand and caused the seal of the Republic of the Philippines to be affixed.

Done in the City of Manila, this 10 th day of July, in the year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Twelve.

By authority of the President: (Sgd.) PAQUITO N. OCHOA JR. Executive Secretary
